title: Escape from Earth
description: Pilot your spaceship and dodge asteroids to escape the planet.
about:
Escape from Earth is a browser game where you pilot the spacecraft and avoid hazards as you try to escape Earth.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Pilot the spacecraft and avoid hazards as you try to escape Earth.
tips: Use on-screen game controls to steer the spacecraft.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Escape from Earth?
faq.answer: Pilot the spacecraft and avoid hazards as you try to escape Earth.

faq.question: Can I play Escape from Earth in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
